allowed_changes: monthly review on first execution session of each new calendar month
use T-1 and earlier Nasdaq CNY prices only
compute sample realized volatility over exactly 21 and 252 return observations
hold 100% Nasdaq when short realized volatility <= long realized volatility; hold 100% gold when short realized volatility > long realized volatility
fixed annual-rebalanced 50/50 Nasdaq-gold barbell and CNY cash controls
product-level 1.00% fee +0.05% slippage with no grid
expected_outputs: owner-by-month audit, trades, cash, realized gross and target fingerprint
global post-protocol DSR after formal run
run authorization, execution commit and SHA artifact manifest
follow_up_policy: After formal metrics are viewed, no volatility window, ratio threshold, smoothing, asset, cadence, hysteresis, weighting, fee/slippage or confirmation-filter rescue is permitted in this lineage.
forbidden_changes: volatility smoothing, EWMA, VIX or ATR substitutes
changing gold/Nasdaq to other assets or blending owners
changing review cadence or adding hysteresis after results
shorting, leverage, financing, gross >100% or negative cash
hypothesis: A sharp rise in Nasdaq short-horizon realized volatility relative to its own long-run 252-session volatility identifies a risk-state transition before large equity drawdowns fully develop. Holding Nasdaq when 21-session realized volatility is at or below the 252-session baseline and switching fully to gold when short volatility exceeds the long baseline may preserve growth participation while reducing equity-tail risk without using price direction, macro factors or leverage.
pass_fail_gates: at least 70% of seven fixed folds have Sharpe >0
max realized gross <=100% and minimum cash >=0
selection_metric: One fixed 21/252 realized-volatility ratio threshold of 1.0 only. No parameter search. Validation, objective attainment and comparison against fixed Nasdaq-gold barbell are separate ATM-SVP-3 axes.

validation_gates: execution-stress evidence deferred and explicitly warned
